CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "loan_account_enriched" AS SELECT
  t2.loan_id,
  t2.account_id,
  CAST(t2.date AS DATE) AS loan_date,
  t2.status AS loan_status,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(t2.amount_duration_payments, '-', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS approved_amount,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(t2.amount_duration_payments, '-', 2) AS INTEGER) AS duration_months,
  CAST(SPLIT_PART(t2.amount_duration_payments, '-', 3) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_payment,
  UPPER(t1.freq_part1) AS freq_part1,
  REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(t1.freq_part2),

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    loan_id,
    loan_date,
    approved_amount,
    freq_part1,
    freq_part2
  FROM loan_account_enriched
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM loan_date) = 1997
    AND UPPER(COALESCE(freq_part2, '')) = 'TYDNE'
), min_amt AS (
  SELECT MIN(approved_amount) AS min_amount FROM filtered
)
SELECT
  f.account_id,
  f.loan_id,
  f.loan_date,
  f.approved_amount AS lowest_approved_amount
FROM filtered f
JOIN min_amt m
  ON f.approved_amount = m.min_amount
ORDER BY f.account_id, f.loan_id

sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    loan_id,
    loan_date,
    approved_amount,
    freq_part1,
    freq_part2
  FROM loan_account_enriched
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM loan_date) = 1997
    AND UPPER(COALESCE(freq_part2, '')) = 'TYDNE'
), min_amt AS (
  SELECT MIN(approved_amount) AS min_amount FROM filtered
)
SELECT
  f.account_id,
  f.loan_id,
  f.loan_date,
  f.approved_amount AS lowest_approved_amount
FROM filtered f
JOIN min_amt m
  ON f.approved_amount = m.min_amount
ORDER BY f.account_id, f.loan_id
"""
